settings.title: Information We Collect
settings.content:
When you visit our website or purchase from us, we may collect information such as:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Billing and shipping address
  • Order and purchase information
  • Payment-related information
  • Product preferences and shopping activity
  • Device, browser, IP address, and website usage information
  • Information you provide when contacting our customer support

settings.title: How We Use Your Information
settings.content:
We use your information to:

  • Process and deliver your orders
  • Confirm and manage purchases
  • Provide shipping and delivery updates
  • Respond to customer support requests
  • Process returns, exchanges, and refunds
  • Improve our products, website, and shopping experience
  • Prevent fraud and protect our website
  • Send promotional emails or offers where you have provided appropriate consent
  • Comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements

settings.title: Shopify
settings.content: Our online store is powered by Shopify, which provides the ecommerce platform used to sell our products and process customer transactions.

settings.title: Privacy Policy
settings.description:
At MOKO, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website, browse our products, or place an order with us.
